# Agent Python Tools

## File: shiyu-coder_Kronos/model/kronos.py

Prompts

```
['create a KronosPredictor instance to generate stock price predictions from historical DataFrame data', 'predict future stock prices and volume using KronosPredictor.predict with historical DataFrame and timestamps', 'batch predict multiple stock time series in parallel using KronosPredictor.predict_batch', 'encode input time series into quantized token indices using KronosTokenizer.encode', 'decode quantized token indices back to reconstructed time series using KronosTokenizer.decode', 'create a BinarySphericalQuantizer module for quantizing embedding vectors with configurable entropy penalties', 'build a HierarchicalEmbedding module that splits composite token IDs into coarse and fine subtoken embeddings', 'build a TransformerBlock with RMSNorm, MultiHeadAttentionWithRoPE, and FeedForward for autoregressive sequence modeling', 'run differentiable codebook entropy computation for quantizer training regularization', 'create a TemporalEmbedding module that encodes minute, hour, weekday, day, and month time features']
```

Usage

```
{'create_kronos_predictor': 'create a KronosPredictor instance to generate stock price predictions from historical DataFrame data', 'predict_stock_prices': 'predict future stock prices and volume using KronosPredictor.predict with historical DataFrame and timestamps', 'batch_predict_series': 'batch predict multiple stock time series in parallel using KronosPredictor.predict_batch', 'encode_quantize_input': 'encode input time series into quantized token indices using KronosTokenizer.encode', 'decode_quantized_tokens': 'decode quantized token indices back to reconstructed time series using KronosTokenizer.decode'}
```
